# HaiLanGo

> HaiLanGo is an AI-powered language learning platform that transforms your existing textbooks into interactive learning experiences. Built entirely with Reinhardt (Rust), it combines OCR, TTS, STT, and AI technologies to provide personalized 24/7 language instruction.

## Technology Stack

Built with [Reinhardt](https://github.com/kent8192/reinhardt-web) - a composable full-stack Rust framework (Django-inspired):

- **reinhardt-db**: ORM with SeaQuery/sqlx (PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite)
- **reinhardt-pages**: WASM + SSR reactive frontend (Leptos/Solid.js style)
- **reinhardt-rest**: REST API with ViewSets and Serializers
- **reinhardt-auth**: JWT, Token, Session, Basic authentication
- **reinhardt-admin**: Auto-generated admin panel
- **reinhardt-websockets**: Real-time communication
- **Redis**: Caching and session storage (separate dependency)

## Core Concept

HaiLanGo enables users to:
- Upload their own language learning books (PDF/images)
- Extract text via OCR with multi-language support
- Listen to native pronunciation via TTS
- Practice speaking with AI-powered pronunciation evaluation
- Learn with spaced repetition (SRS) algorithm
- Use "Teacher Mode" for hands-free audio lessons

## Supported Languages

Primary: Japanese, English, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish
Extended: Persian, Hebrew, and any language supported by TTS/STT APIs

## Key Features

1. **Book Digitization**: Upload PDF or images, extract text with OCR
2. **Interactive Learning**: Page-by-page study with audio playback
3. **Teacher Mode**: Automated lesson playback for passive learning
4. **Pronunciation Practice**: Real-time feedback with scoring (0-100)
5. **Spaced Repetition**: SM-2 algorithm for optimal review scheduling
6. **Offline Support**: PWA with service worker caching

## External APIs

- OCR: Google Vision API / Azure Computer Vision
- TTS: Google Cloud TTS / Azure Speech
- STT: OpenAI Whisper / Azure Speech
- LLM: Anthropic Claude API
- Payments: Stripe
